what: Like circus signage, the bulbs on the top and bottom rows of the frame sit at .3 brightness at rest. Every .5~1.5s one of the on-screen cards is picked and a wave (1.1s · trailing positions at (1−n)^2.5) is sent, with two heads circling the perimeter to light and cool the bulbs. On hover it heats up in .05s, each bulb lights in .06s after a 0~.25s stagger, three of them flicker at 14Hz up to .35 for the first .4s, and on release it cools in .8s

options.[data-fx-part=row]: Bulb string — each child inside is one bulb. The second row is chained in reverse to form a loop around the edge (top left→right, bottom right→left)

from.where: cards.js .pp-artist (twelve beads each above and below the performer frame) — original lights: rest .3 · every 1 · wave rounds .9 heads 2 tail 2.5 · heat in .05 out .8 · on spread .25 warm .06 · flicker 3 beads .4s 14Hz dim .35

note: Ripples pass between on-screen cards one line at a time, alternating (the whole part runs on one clock). A finger heats it up once on press, then it cools
